steps.name: Boiling
steps.//: this is technically cheating on energy, as you need to boil the water longer to really cook the egg.
steps.//1: However, water that boiled an egg in it doesn't get contaminated and you'd keep putting eggs into the same boiling water, so this recipe uses water as a tool and has lentient energy use.
steps.//2: At 15 minutes the egg white becomes rubbery and the yoke becomes dry, but at 2 hours the egg becomes inedible
